system.description: • Effect: Your Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures, as if you were a Cleric 4 levels lower. A fiend or other extraplanar creature that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level; otherwise it is turned.

activities.name: Banish
activities.text: Turn fiends and other extraplanar creatures as you would undead, as a Cleric 4 levels lower. One that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level; otherwise it is turned.

activities.name: Banish
activities.text: Turn fiends and other extraplanar creatures as you would undead, at your full level, banishing 1d12 minor or 1d6 major demons or devils, or one lord, for 21+ days.
